metadata.name: WebFrameworkAdapters
metadata.description: Guides > Web framework adapters. How `web_framework` in rjui.config.json retargets rjui's emit to any React-family framework (jsonui-cli 1.6.7). Six sections: the seam's coverage (RSC directive, Link wiring, router import/hook/type, template rewrite), the two declaration forms (built-in name string vs custom adapter object, unknown-name build error, byte-identical round-trip back to next), the eight adapter keys with their neutral defaults (all optional, router_type defaults to any, router_type_jsdoc falls back to router_type), declaration semantics (empty string suppresses the whole line, unknown keys and non-string values fail the build), worked examples (the full-coverage Remix adapter and a minimal TanStack Start one), and template directive rewriting (NetworkImage / useColorMode). ~6-min read.

uiVariables.name: nextReadLinks
uiVariables.description: Three closing cards: ReactJsonUI platform page, navigation guide, jui config reference.

notes: 2026-08-18 — New page, requested alongside the jsonui-cli 1.6.7 uptake: the adapter seam ended the Next-only web story, so the site both revises its Next-assumed claims and documents the adapter contract in one dedicated place.

Canonical source: rjui_tools/lib/core/frameworks.rb (NextAdapter reference strings, CustomAdapter STRING_KEYS/DEFAULTS/validation, apply_directive for template rewriting). The key table and error semantics in sections 3-4 are transcribed from that file, not from the release notes.

The Remix example is the reference adapter shipped in the seam's own documentation (all eight keys, empty directive, JSDoc spelling). The TanStack Start example is deliberately minimal — Link + router wiring only, everything else falling back — and its prose says to tighten router_type later rather than asserting a specific exported type name.
This page's layout file is kebab-case (web-framework-adapters.json); own-section string resolution for kebab basenames requires jsonui-cli >= 1.6.5.
